desc:
🎈 Welcome to Harpoon a Dragon!

🔥 Heat up your balloon and fly higher to discover and catch flying creatures! Fill your Index with 150+ unique animals, from tiny birds to giant SECRET dragons! 🐉

🌌 Rise through 7 zones: Treetops, Bird Highway, Cloudlands, Thunderstorm, Aurora, Moonbase and the Galaxy! But watch out, the higher you fly, the rarer and stronger the animals get...

🌈 Catch mutated animals! Gold, Rainbow and more. Better harpoons give better mutation chances!

🔱 Collect 100 harpoon rods with unique effects. Open crates with keys and find the rarest one!

🪺 Put your catches in your nest and let them GROW into the biggest and rarest space dragon you can find!

[How to Harpoon]
🎯 Aim at your target and FIRE!
🧵 Time your clicks to reel it in!
🔥 Upgrade your burner to fly even higher!
🪺 Put your catches in your nest and watch them grow!

🎁 Free codes: RELEASE, BIRDS, HARPOON

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for more updates!
